items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, maintains neutral stance
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee unanimously decided to keep the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% in its August meeting, maintaining a neutral policy stance.

items.headline: RBI minutes reveal hawkish inflation assessment, hint at potential rate hikes
items.summary: Minutes from the August MPC meeting showed some members assessed inflation more hawkishly, indicating potential rate hikes later in the year if inflationary pressures persist. RBI Governor projected inflation to peak at 5.9% in Q3 FY27.

items.headline: Core WPI inflation surges to 8.2%, food inflation at 19-month high
items.summary: While overall Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation marginally eased to 9.8% in July 2026, core WPI inflation surged to a series-high of 8.2%, and food inflation hardened to 6.6%.

items.headline: CPI inflation accelerates to 4.45% in July, exceeds RBI target
items.summary: Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation accelerated to 4.45% in July, exceeding the RBI's 4% medium-term target for the second consecutive month, primarily driven by food and beverages due to an uneven monsoon.

items.headline: Core infrastructure sector growth moderates to 5.4% in July
items.summary: Provisional data for July 2026 showed core infrastructure sector growth moderated to 5.4% year-on-year from 6% in June, with natural gas, crude oil, and fertilizers contracting.

items.headline: Global markets mixed; US ends positive, Asian markets up, but crude oil remains elevated
items.summary: US markets ended positively with S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq edging up, supported by easing bond market pressure. Asian markets generally traded higher. However, elevated crude oil prices (Brent above $93) and US-Iran conflict uncertainty persist.

items.headline: Gift Nifty indicates flat-to-positive opening for Indian markets
items.summary: Trends from Gift Nifty suggest Indian benchmark indices are poised for a flat to slightly positive opening on August 21.

items.headline: FIIs net sellers, DIIs net buyers in Indian equities
items.summary: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net sellers of Indian equities worth ₹583 crore on Thursday, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) were net buyers at ₹3,538 crore.

items.headline: Manipal Health Enterprises reports 38.1% revenue increase in Q1 FY27
items.summary: Manipal Health Enterprises announced a 38.1% increase in revenue to ₹3,091 crore for the first quarter of FY27.

items.headline: Rane Holdings to hold Earnings Conference Call for Q1 FY27 results today
items.summary: Rane Holdings Limited has scheduled an Earnings Conference Call for August 21, 2026, to discuss its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

items.headline: Flexituff Ventures, Innova Captab among companies to announce Q1 results today
items.summary: Flexituff Ventures International, Boston Commerce Ltd, Innova Captab, and Octavius Plantations are scheduled to announce their quarterly results on August 21, 2026.

items.headline: Nifty Realty leads broad-based market recovery; PSU Bank, Chemicals sectors lag
items.summary: The Nifty Realty index was the strongest performer on Thursday, rising nearly 1.5%. Other sectors like FMCG, IT, Financial Services, Consumer Durables, Auto, Pharma, and Metal also saw strong buying, while Nifty PSU Bank and Chemicals sectors ended lower.

items.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics JV Infotech HAL dissolved by NCLT Bengaluru
items.summary: The 50:50 joint venture Infotech HAL, involving Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, has been dissolved by the NCLT Bengaluru.

items.headline: YES BANK enhances working capital facility for CMR Green Technologies
items.summary: YES BANK increased CMR Green Technologies' working capital facility from ₹150 crore to ₹200 crore on August 20, 2026.

items.headline: RailTel secures ₹164.79 crore order from Western Coalfields
items.summary: RailTel Corporation of India secured a significant ₹164.79 crore order from Western Coalfields to establish an MPLS VPN network on a 60-month rental basis, contributing to reported massive order wins and record revenues.

items.headline: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering approves ₹330 crore rights issue
items.summary: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering approved a ₹330 crore rights issue, offering 1.25 crore equity shares at ₹264/share in a 7:40 ratio.

items.headline: SIS increases stake in UDS with additional share acquisition
items.summary: SIS acquired an additional 10.27 lakh UDS shares for ₹21.59 crore, raising its stake to 8.19%.

items.headline: TeamLease divests entire 30% stake in Crystal HR for ₹10.12 crore
items.summary: TeamLease Services divested its entire 30% stake in Crystal HR for ₹10.12 crore, with the joint venture ceasing operations after a buyback.

items.headline: DMart allots commercial paper, opens new store in Maharashtra
items.summary: DMart allotted ₹200 crore commercial paper maturing November 18, 2026, at 6.50% and opened a new store in Navsari, Amravati, Maharashtra, bringing its total store count to 507.

items.headline: Rallis India announces CFO change, Bhaskar Swaminathan to exit
items.summary: Bhaskar Swaminathan will exit as CFO of Rallis India on November 4, 2026, with Sridhar Radhakrishnan appointed as the new CFO effective the same date.

items.headline: RITES CMD Rahul Mithal's tenure extended until June 2027
items.summary: RITES extended the tenure of its Chairman and Managing Director, Rahul Mithal, beyond October 6, 2026, until June 30, 2027.

items.headline: L&T Finance allots NCDs worth ₹235 crore via private placement
items.summary: L&T Finance allotted 23,500 NCDs worth ₹235 crore on a private placement basis on August 20, 2026.

items.headline: ICRA reaffirms Niva Bupa Health Insurance rating, assigns for proposed debt
items.summary: ICRA reaffirmed Niva Bupa Health Insurance's issuer rating at [ICRA]AAA (Stable) and assigned an [ICRA]AA+ (Stable) rating to a proposed subordinated debt of up to ₹500 crore.

items.headline: Goodluck India shares surge ahead of 2:1 bonus issue, Q1 FY27 profit up 67%
items.summary: Goodluck India shares surged over 6% ahead of its 2:1 bonus share issue record date of August 21, 2026. The company also reported strong Q1 FY27 results with revenue up 31%, EBITDA jumping 46%, and PAT surging by 67%.

items.headline: Hyundai Motor India to hike vehicle prices by up to 1% from September
items.summary: Hyundai Motor India announced plans to hike vehicle prices by up to 1% across its model range starting from September 2026.

items.headline: Autoline Industries wins new order from Tata Motors
items.summary: Autoline Industries secured a new order from Tata Motors, indicating potential growth in its business.

items.headline: LIC receives RBI approval to raise stake in HDFC Bank to 9.99%
items.summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) received approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to raise its stake in HDFC Bank to 9.99%.

items.headline: Ganesh Benzoplast wins Supreme Court case, Q1 FY27 revenue jumps 23%
items.summary: Ganesh Benzoplast secured a key legal victory as the Supreme Court dismissed Progfin's insolvency appeal. The company also reported a 23% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 revenue to ₹1,175 crore, though EBITDA margin narrowed.

items.headline: Diamond Power Infrastructure posts 268% profit surge, commissions new copper cable line
items.summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure reported a 268% surge in profit and successfully commissioned a new copper cable line, signaling operational expansion and improved profitability.

items.headline: Augmont Enterprises IPO opens today, Gaja Alternative Asset Management IPO closes
items.summary: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) for Augmont Enterprises opens on August 21, 2026, while the Gaja Alternative Asset Management IPO closes on the same day.

items.headline: BPCL, HAL, RailTel, Samvardhana Motherson among stocks to watch today
items.summary: BPCL, Hindustan Aeronautics (HAL), RailTel, Saatvik Green Energy, and Samvardhana Motherson International are expected to be in focus due to recent corporate developments.

items.headline: Bharti Hexacom receives shareholder approval to sell mobile towers
items.summary: Bharti Hexacom received shareholder approval to sell mobile towers to a sister concern for ₹1,134 crore.

items.headline: Shanti Gold International Q1 FY26 net profit soars 174%
items.summary: Shanti Gold International reported a 174% increase in net profit to ₹24.64 crore for Q1 FY26, with revenue from operations climbing 22% to ₹292.77 crore.

items.headline: SBI Cards to hold in-person analyst and investor meeting today
items.summary: SBI Cards and Payment Services is scheduled to hold an in-person analyst and investor meeting today, August 21.

items.headline: Eternal, Shriram Finance, Kotak Mahindra Bank were top gainers on August 20
items.summary: Eternal, Shriram Finance, and Kotak Mahindra Bank were among the top gaining stocks on August 20, reflecting positive market sentiment for these counters.

items.headline: Tata Consumer, Hindalco, IndiGo lead as top laggards on August 20
items.summary: Tata Consumer, Hindalco Industries, and InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo) were the leading laggards in the market on August 20.

items.headline: Manipal Health, RailTel, Tata Motors PV, Tata Steel in focus after post-market announcements
items.summary: Manipal Health, RailTel, Tata Motors PV, and Tata Steel will be in focus following various corporate announcements made after market hours on Thursday.

content.outlook: Indian equities closed notably higher, with Nifty 50 and Sensex gaining over 0.6% and 0.8% respectively, driven by broad-based buying. Realty, FMCG, and IT sectors led the charge, supported by strong DII inflows which offset FII selling. The positive market breadth and a stable VIX suggest a constructive sentiment heading into the open.
keyTakeaways: Nifty 50 and Sensex posted solid gains of 0.64% and 0.82% respectively.
Realty (+1.41%), FMCG (+0.82%), and IT (+0.79%) sectors were the top performers.
Market breadth was positive with 41 advances against 15 declines.
Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) were strong net buyers with +3537.71cr, offsetting FII outflows of -583.36cr.
VEDL (+2.1%), Kotak Bank (+1.8%), Britannia (+1.7%), ITC (+1.7%), and Bajaj Finance (+1.4%) featured among top gainers.
India VIX remains subdued at 10.755, indicating lower volatility expectations.
